records.question: Tom needs to lower a rope down 6 stories.   One story is 10 feet.  The only rope being sold is 20 feet long but you lose 25% when lashing them together.  How many pieces of rope will he need to buy?
records.response:
One story is 10 feet, so 6 stories is 6*10 = 60 feet.
When lashing the ropes together, Tom loses 25% of the length of the rope, so he needs to buy 60/0.75 = 80 feet of rope.
Each piece of rope is 20 feet long, so Tom needs to buy 80/20 = 4 pieces of rope.

records.question: Reggie and his brother are having a basketball shooting contest. They each get to take 10 shots. Layups are worth 1 point, free throws are worth 2 points, and anything further away is worth 3 points. Reggie makes 3 layups, two free throws, and one long shot. His brother only shoots long shots and makes 4 of them. How many points does Reggie lose by?
records.response:
Reggie makes 3 layups, so he scores 3 * 1 = 3 points.
He makes two free throws, so he scores 2 * 2 = 4 points.
He makes one long shot, so he scores 1 * 3 = 3 points.
In total, Reggie scores 3 + 4 + 3 = 10 points.
His brother makes 4 long shots, so he scores 4 * 3 = 12 points.
Reggie loses by 12 - 10 = 2 points.
